frontendRoots.note: Route roots are literal dynamic import() targets in the Phase 1 entry JS. Both TV and web shells share the same build baseUrl and observationId; relative paths are keyed only under that single build root (never merged across deployments). For the Floatplane Vite shell, the ternary then-branch is TV and the else-branch is web.
